title: Application of Eastern Edison Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 131, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the Company's Oil Conservation Adjustment charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings taken in the billing months of June, July and August 1986. The Oil Conservation Adjustment surcharge receives the cost of conversion from oil-fired to coal-fired generation and its calculation is based on the competitive costs of burning coal and oil.
